name: Body Pulse
summary: Coordinate one adjustable Platform Heartbeat with bounded verification, honest workload and pressure evidence, a dormant candidate-draft queue, and an independently gated private Mirror lesson lane.
actions: inspect retained workload and pressure evidence
inspect recent candidate draft run receipts
open the technical-first plain-language review surface for an exact candidate
explicitly enable or disable only the Mirror lesson lane
notes: Heartbeat decides when eligibility is checked; Pulse limits how many opportunities may run; gates decide whether. New code drafting is packaged dormant and capped at one per hour if explicitly re-enabled; existing review candidates remain available for up to seven days and route to the Command Center for a technical-first plain-language decision. The private Mirror lesson lane is packaged off, requires separate Heartbeat, Pulse and Mirror opt-ins, and admits only dual-reviewed receipt facts. Workload duration is wall-clock evidence, while CPU and memory claims require bounded Body Pulse samples. Nothing here applies, trains, publishes, pushes, merges, promotes, edits CANON, or changes original Mirror.
